description: Plan a multi-leg rail / public-transport journey between two places in Europe. Pass station NAMES ("Berlin Hbf" -> "München Hbf") or stop ids. Returns route options, each with total duration, number of transfers, and every leg (mode, line, from/to with platforms, scheduled + real-time times). Keyless.

departure.description: ISO date/time to depart at (e.g. "2026-07-25T18:00:00Z"). Defaults to now.

from.description: Origin station name or stop id, e.g. "Berlin Hbf".

results.description: Max journey options to return (default 3, max 6).

to.description: Destination station name or stop id, e.g. "München Hbf".

name: dbrail_journeys
title: Dbrail Journeys
